detailed_description:
The target video is photorealistic and live-action in a dark-fantasy style, lit by warm, flickering candlelight with deep shadows and a shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] The camera holds a static shot for the entire clip, locked off with no pan, tilt, zoom, or drift, keeping the eye-level, waist-up composition of <Picture 2> from the first frame to the last. <Subject 1> stands in the center of the frame facing the lens, the gold filigree on her scalp, face, and chest catching the candlelight, her dark red mantle over her shoulders and her bandaged forearms at her sides. Behind her, <Subject 2> stays softly blurred, with candle flames flickering on the iron candelabras and the statue dim in its niche. She looks straight into the camera and talks to the viewer like a vlogger. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in the voice from <Audio 1>: <d>[English] {{transcript}}</d> Her lips, jaw, and the muscles around her sunken mouth form every syllable precisely in sync with <Audio 1>, closing completely during pauses. Her emotion follows the meaning of each phrase and the delivery in <Audio 1>. When the words are warm or amused, her eyes narrow slightly and the corners of her mouth lift. When they are angry, insistent, or threatening, her brow lowers, her gaze hardens, and she leans in a little. When they are sad or reflective, her eyes soften and drift briefly away from the lens before returning, and her head tilts down. When they are surprised or excited, her eyes widen and her eyebrows rise. Her head moves naturally with her speech: small nods on emphasized words, slight tilts at the ends of questions, and brief turns to the side between thoughts, always returning to face the camera. Her hands come up into frame at chest height to gesture with the rhythm of the words, opening outward to explain, pointing toward the lens to address the viewer, pressing to her chest when speaking about herself, and rising with spread fingers on emphatic words, then lowering to her sides during pauses. She blinks naturally and breathes between phrases, her shoulders rising and falling. Her feet stay planted; she never steps, turns away, or leaves the center of the frame, and her clothing, filigree, and the background stay consistent throughout. When she finishes speaking, she closes her mouth and holds a calm, steady gaze on the camera until the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet, faintly echoing chapel room tone continues throughout, with the soft crackle of candle flames and the light rustle of her leather mantle and fabric as her arms move.
